headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

The Detroit Tigers edged the Kansas City Royals 2-1, securing a narrow victory. Tarik Skubal led the Tigers' pitching effort with 7.1 innings pitched, 12 strikeouts, and 1 earned run. The Royals secured a 3-2 victory over the Tigers in a separate matchup, with Carter Jensen, Salvador Perez, and Vinnie Pasquantino making notable contributions.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Josh Jung of the Texas Rangers, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain. Other players on the injured list include Spencer Arrighetti of the Houston Astros, Juan Soto of the New York Mets, Shawn Armstrong of the Cleveland Guardians, Tanner Banks of the Philadelphia Phillies, Rafael Flores Jr. of the Pittsburgh Pirates, and Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies.

The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash, while the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for Future Considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin, and the Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Caleb Thielbar earning the win and Gavin Hollowell securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Nationals in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks took down the Washington Nationals 3-2, with Eduardo Rodriguez earning the win and Paul Sewald securing the save.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Key contributors for the Royals included Carter Jensen, Salvador Perez, and Vinnie Pasquantino, while the Tigers' Riley Greene and Hao-Yu Lee made notable impacts in the loss.

top_news.title: **Jung Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers third baseman Josh Jung has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026. Jung's status will be reassessed after the 10-day period.

top_news.title: **Royals Make Trade Debut**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made their first trade of the season, sending CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash.
